10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:2ec08985-65dd-4f.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced insurance broker who instinctively spots coverage issues and understands the complex realities of the insurance industry? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies insurance expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable insurance brokers based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered insurance systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to insurance policies, risk assessments, claims processes, and practical aspects of brokerage work - Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, practicality, and compliance with real-world insurance requirements - Draft realistic insurance scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. broker, client, insurer, or regulator) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated insurance content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects true insurance reasoning, authentic documentation, and practical procedures. Rather than conducting traditional insurance brokerage projects, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about insurance at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level insurance broker with significant professional experience within the EU or UK - Experienced in advising on, preparing, and executing insurance solutions and claims - Skilled at evaluating documentation, risk assessments, and compliance - Comfortable working independently and providing structured, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with prompt availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your current commitments - Apply your insurance expertise in a rapidly evolving, high-impact AI environment - Directly contribute to building advanced AI insurance systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further develop your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured tasks, and ongoing opportunities for collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the insurance expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:483f5f86-6d51-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Research Scientist based in United States. This is an impactful research role at the intersection of educational science, data, assessment, and real-world decision-making. You will join a research-focused team that partners with school districts, researchers, educators, and internal stakeholders to address complex questions through rigorous evidence. The role combines advanced quantitative analysis with research consulting, requiring you to translate technical findings into practical and actionable guidance. You will work with large-scale assessment and education datasets while contributing to applied research and scalable resources. The position offers significant autonomy, cross-functional collaboration, and opportunities to influence how research informs K–12 education. You will also engage directly with external partners through consultations, presentations, and research projects. Serve as a trusted research advisor to school districts, researchers, educators, and internal stakeholders, helping them interpret assessment data and research evidence appropriately for educational decision-making. Lead research consulting engagements from initial scoping through delivery by clarifying questions, defining appropriate methodologies, conducting analyses, and communicating findings and recommendations. Independently access, query, analyze, and manage large-scale assessment datasets using tools such as R, Python, or SQL within a Snowflake data environment. Apply advanced expertise in educational research, assessment, measurement, and research design to address complex, ambiguous, and partner-specific questions. Translate technical research findings, statistical analyses, and assessment concepts into clear, practical guidance for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise. Design and deliver partner-facing presentations, technical consultations, custom analyses, data visualizations, research reports, policy briefs, practitioner materials, and other accessible research products. Collaborate across research, education, technology, and business teams to respond effectively to partner needs while identifying opportunities to create reusable resources and scalable solutions. Conduct and contribute to rigorous applied research using large-scale assessment and longitudinal education data in alignment with broader research priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships with educators, district leaders, researchers, and cross-functional colleagues. Manage multiple consulting engagements and research responsibilities simultaneously while maintaining high-quality deliverables and agreed timelines. Travel approximately 10–20% of the time for partner engagements, conferences, and other internal or external events. Requirements Ph.D. in Education, Educational Measurement, Public Policy, Economics, Psychology, Sociology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience conducting educational research and/or providing research, data, or assessment consultation, preferably involving large-scale assessment or longitudinal education data. Strong quantitative research expertise and the ability to select and apply appropriate methodologies to applied research questions. Proficiency with statistical and analytical tools such as R, Stata, Python, or similar software; strong SQL skills and experience independently querying large-scale datasets are preferred. Experience working directly with educators, district or state leaders, researchers, or other stakeholders to scope and address research and data questions. Demonstrated ability to translate complex research findings, analyses, and assessment concepts into practical recommendations for nontechnical audiences. jobgether-jobgether:lever:69fe4ddc-57f6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Operations Manager (Demand Generation and RevOps) based in India. This is a hands-on marketing operations role focused on building and maintaining a high-performing, outbound-first go-to-market engine. You will own the day-to-day health of the marketing technology stack, with HubSpot serving as the central system of record. The role spans CRM administration, email deliverability, paid media monitoring, reporting, content execution, data quality, and targeting. You will work across technical configuration and campaign execution while using performance data to identify opportunities for improvement. The position offers significant ownership in a fast-paced, remote environment where accuracy, initiative, and operational discipline are highly valued. You will also collaborate with Sales and wider go-to-market stakeholders to ensure marketing activity is measurable, scalable, and aligned with revenue objectives. Own email infrastructure and deliverability, including mailbox provisioning, domain configuration, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warm-up programs, sending-volume management, reputation monitoring, and campaign performance analysis. Administer and continuously improve HubSpot CRM, Marketing Hub, and Sales Hub, including pipelines, workflows, automation, lifecycle management, integrations, properties, lists, and user support. Maintain high standards of CRM data quality by managing imports, deduplication, record validation, lifecycle progression, marketing-contact governance, tagging, exclusions, and data-quality queues. Monitor workflow, integration, attribution, and platform health to ensure reliable data flows and accurate source-to-revenue reporting. Produce weekly and monthly multi-channel performance reports, dashboards, funnel diagnostics, attribution analyses, and leadership performance packs. Monitor paid media performance, budget pacing, delivery health, landing-page conversion, and spend reconciliation across advertising platforms. Develop and refresh campaign assets, nurture sequences, landing-page copy, SEO content briefs, and other marketing materials to support demand-generation programs. Maintain targeting and data processes, including suppression alignment, trigger-event monitoring, target-universe scoring, and coordination with external data and outreach vendors. Coordinate LinkedIn outbound activities, ensuring appropriate sender-seat allocation, avoiding prospect duplication, and monitoring acceptance and response rates. Support vendor management, tool renewals, licensing, seat allocation, exclusion-list synchronization, and prospect-collision resolution. Maintain brand and website governance by enforcing approved terminology, addressing legacy content, preparing page briefs, and quality-checking delivered web pages. Forecast marketing expenditure and manage budget change control while contributing to ongoing operational planning and governance. Participate in weekly operational meetings, biweekly progress reviews, and monthly revenue reviews, with availability to overlap with U.S. business hours. Requirements: 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand-generation operations, or revenue operations, including at least 3 years of hands-on HubSpot administration. Strong working knowledge of HubSpot CRM, Marketing Hub, and Sales Hub, including workflows, automation, pipelines, lifecycle management, reporting, and user governance. Proven experience managing cold-email infrastructure, including domain and mailbox provisioning, warm-up, sending rotation, reputation monitoring, and SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration. Demonstrated ability to manage email deliverability against bounce and complaint thresholds and take corrective action when performance deteriorates.
